name: Sarandë in a day
description_md:
Sarande in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city main sights. This route is anchored in Sarande, AL and features five sightseeing stops.

The full day takes about 6.1 hours, which includes visit time at each stop. Walkers cover 10.5 km of walking between stops during the trip.
